## Company Overview

Brand Name: RB International Belting & Automation
Legal Entity: R.B. Traders (Partnership Firm)
Established: 23 October 2003
GST Registered: Yes (GSTIN: 27AAHFR3595G1ZU)
MSME Udyam Registered: Yes (UDYAM-MH-26-0109721)
Team Size: 15+ employees

RB International Belting & Automation is the brand name of R.B. Traders, a partnership firm registered in Pune, Maharashtra, India. The company is based in Bhosari Industrial Estate, Pune, one of India's largest MIDC (Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation) zones. RB International operates three product divisions: Power Transmission (belts, pulleys, couplings and drive components), Automation and Motion Control (linear motion, robotics, servo systems, CNC components), and Industrial Adhesives and Chemicals (marketed as RB Adhesive Company, handled by a dedicated team within R.B. Traders). The company supplies to 500+ active manufacturing clients across India including MSMEs, large corporates, OEMs, and government units. Exporting since 2025, RB International ships power transmission and automation products to the Middle East, Australia, Southeast Asia, Africa, and South Asia.

## Pricing

RB International does not publish fixed pricing. All pricing is quotation-based and varies by product type, brand, quantity, delivery location, and order frequency. The team provides detailed best-discounted quotes tailored to each specific requirement. Contact the sales team with your product specifications, quantity, and delivery location for a custom quote.

## Delivery and Dispatch

Same day dispatch available for stocked items. Ships within 24 to 48 hours for most standard products in stock. For custom manufactured or made-to-order items, delivery timelines depend on manufacturing schedules and are confirmed by the team at the time of order placement. Contact the sales team for delivery estimates on specific products.

## PRODUCT RANGE 1: POWER TRANSMISSION (Belts, Pulleys, Couplings and Drive Components)

### V-Belts
Classical V-Belts (A, B, C, D, E sections), Narrow V-Belts (SPA, SPB, SPC, SPZ profiles), Micro V-Belts (PJ, PK, PL, PM multi-rib series), Banded V-Belts, Variable Speed Belts, Link V-Belts (Nutlink adjustable length), Cogged V-Belts (raw edge, notched), Wedge Belts, Heavy Duty V-Belts, Double Sided V-Belts, Hexagonal Belts, 2-Wheeler EV Drive Belts.
Brands available: Fenner, Gates, Optibelt, PIX, Continental ContiTech, Megadyne, Carlisle, Hutchinson, Mitsuboshi, Goodyear Eagle NRG, Bando, Ecodrive, Polymaxx.
Applications: Air compressors, centrifugal pumps, submersible pumps, blowers, exhaust fans, lathe machines, milling machines, grinding machines, textile looms, packaging machines, conveyor drives, crushers, mixers, HVAC units, diesel generators, printing machines, rice mill equipment, sugar cane crushers, flour mill machines, agricultural equipment, electric vehicle drivetrains.

### Timing Belts (Synchronous Belts)
Rubber Timing Belts, PU Timing Belts, PU Coated Timing Belts, Gates Polychain GT Carbon Belts, Gates Polyflex JB Belts, HTD Timing Belts, Eagle PD Timing Belts, AT Series Timing Belts, T Series Timing Belts, XL/L/H/XH/XXH Profile Timing Belts, 3M/5M/8M/14M Pitch Timing Belts, Double Sided Timing Belts, Custom Welded Endless PU Timing Belts, Open Ended PU Timing Belts with Steel or Kevlar Cord.
Brands available: Fenner, Gates, Optibelt, Megadyne, Goodyear, Eagle PD, Continental ContiTech, Carlisle, Bando, Mitsuboshi, Polymaxx.
Applications: CNC routers, CNC machines, pick-and-place systems, packaging lines, labelling machines, printing presses, bottling and filling lines, paper converting machines, textile spinning frames, injection moulding machines, medical diagnostic equipment, 3D printers, laser cutting machines, automatic doors and gates, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, solar panel manufacturing lines, EV component assembly, wafer handling systems.

### Conveyor Belts
PU Conveyor Belts, PVC Conveyor Belts, Food Grade Conveyor Belts (FDA compliant, white and blue), Plastic Modular Conveyor Belts, Steel Modular Belts, Rubber Conveyor Belts (EP, NN, steel cord), Elevator Belts (bucket elevator), Vacuum Belts, Cleated Conveyor Belts, Sidewall Conveyor Belts, Rough Top Conveyor Belts, Heat Resistant Conveyor Belts, Oil Resistant Conveyor Belts, Fire Resistant Conveyor Belts, Anti-Static Conveyor Belts, Caterpillar Belts, Semiconductor Clean Room Conveyor Belts, Solar Panel Handling Belts, EV Battery Line Conveyor Belts.
Brands available: Fenner, Gates, Habasit, Nitta, Megadyne, Optibelt, Continental ContiTech, Bando.
Applications: Food processing lines, pharmaceutical tablet and capsule lines, airport baggage systems, warehouse sorting lines, bottling and canning plants, cement plants, mining and quarry transport, packaging end-of-line, grain handling and agro processing, bakery and confectionery lines, recycling and waste sorting, assembly line material transfer, cold storage and frozen food handling, solar panel manufacturing, semiconductor wafer handling, EV battery assembly lines, lithium-ion cell production, clean room material handling.

### Flat Belts
Flat Transmission Belts, Steel Cord Flat Belts, Round PU Cords and Belts, Woven Belts, Tangential Belts, Flat Belts with Friction Coating, Polyamide Flat Belts.
Brands available: Fenner, Habasit, Nitta, Megadyne, Optibelt.
Applications: High-speed spindle drives, woodworking planers and saws, textile ring frames, paper mill rollers, polishing and buffing machines, leather processing equipment, card clothing machines, light-duty conveying, envelope and stationery machines, tobacco processing equipment.

### Caterpillar Belts
Caterpillar Track Belts for cutting machines, CNC router caterpillar chains, rubber caterpillar pads, haul-off caterpillar belts for extrusion lines, caterpillar belt assemblies for pipe and profile extrusion.
Applications: Plastic pipe extrusion lines, profile extrusion, PVC pipe plants, cable extrusion, wood-plastic composite extrusion, corrugated pipe production.

### V-Pulleys and Bushes
Timing Pulleys (aluminium and steel, all standard tooth profiles), CI Timing Pulleys, V-Pulleys (all section sizes), Taper Lock Bushes (all bore sizes), Keyless Bushes, QD Bushes, Split Taper Bushes, Custom Machined Pulleys.
Applications: All V-belt driven equipment, all timing belt driven equipment, motor-to-shaft power transmission, speed reduction and increase assemblies, conveyor head and tail drums, machine tool spindles, pump drive assemblies, fan and blower shaft assemblies.

### Couplings
Eurogrip Flexible Couplings (jaw type), Servo Couplings (beam, bellows, disc, oldham types), Encoder Couplings, Plum Couplings, Gear Couplings, Grid Couplings, Pin Bush Couplings.
Applications: Motor-to-gearbox connections, servo motor shaft linkage, encoder feedback systems, CNC spindle drives, pump-to-motor coupling, conveyor drive units, stepper motor assemblies, precision positioning systems.

### Accessories and Tools
Belt Tension Testers (digital and analog), Belt Installation Tools, Alignment Tools, Rust Preventives and Cleaners, Bearing and Coupling Maintenance Tools, Drive System Inspection Equipment.

## PRODUCT RANGE 2: AUTOMATION AND MOTION CONTROL

### Linear Motion Systems
Ball Screws (SFU series: SFU1204, SFU1605, SFU2005, SFU2505, SFU3205, SFU4005, SFU1610, SFU2010, SFU2510, SFU3210, SFU4010, SFU5010, SFU6310 and all standard pitches and diameters), Ball Screw Support Units (BK/BF series, FK/FF series), Linear Guideways (HGH/HGW series: HGH15, HGH20, HGH25, HGH30, HGH35 in CA and HA variants), Linear Bearing Blocks (SBR series: SBR10 through SBR50, standard and long types), Linear Shafts (chrome plated, induction hardened, all diameters), Slide Blocks, Racks and Pinions (1.25 module and 1.5 module, C45 carbon steel, up to 1400mm length), Gear Racks, Gear Boxes and Gear Reducers (planetary series, right angle).
Brands available: HIWIN, THK, TOCO, Rexroth, and RB International own brand.
Applications: CNC milling machines, CNC routers (wood, stone, metal), laser cutting machines, plasma cutting tables, industrial 3D printers, pick-and-place gantries, wafer handling (electronics and semiconductor), PCB drilling machines, coordinate measuring machines (CMM), engraving machines, glass cutting tables, die cutting machines, solar panel handling systems, EV battery module assembly.

### Robotics and Actuators
Gantry Robots and Actuators (XYTH Series, Mono Stage), Cartesian Robots, Linear Modules (ball screw driven, belt driven), Linear Actuators, Multi-Axis Positioning Systems, Ball Screw Linear Modules (GGP series).
Applications: Automated assembly lines, material handling gantries, palletizing systems, cartesian pick-and-place, dispensing and gluing systems, welding automation, sorting and grading lines, vision-guided inspection stations, loading and unloading automation, semiconductor handling, solar cell sorting, EV component assembly automation.

### Motors and Drives
Servo Motors (AC servo, range from 2.2KW to 11KW, Alpha series, 750 to 12000 RPM, 380V), Servo Drives, Stepper Motors (57BYG, 86BYG series, 2-phase, 3 to 12 Nm torque), Stepper Drivers (Leadshine HBS series), Frequency Inverters (Best and Fuling brands, 0.75KW to 400KW, 220V and 380V), Spindle Motors (air cooled: 0.3KW to 9KW, water cooled: 0.8KW to 18KW, HQD, CS, GDZ, HDL, HDK, HSD series, ATC spindles BT30 and BT40), Gearboxes (PAB, PPG, PPGA series, planetary gear reducers).
Applications: CNC machine spindles, robotic arm joints, conveyor speed control, packaging machine indexing, textile winding machines, label applicators, rotary tables, automatic sliding doors, semiconductor equipment, pump and fan variable speed control, elevator and lift systems, EV motor testing rigs, solar tracker drives.

### Controllers and Control Systems
CNC Controllers (Shan Long controllers, Mach3 controllers), DSP Controllers (Richauto A11C, A18C, A11E, A18E, 3-axis and 4-axis), Hand Wheels (MPG handwheel, WHC wireless handwheel, WHB wireless series), Mach3 USB Interface Boards (3-axis, 4-axis, 6-axis), Mach3 LAN Motion Control Cards, Tool Setters (HNC GZ-36, GZ-66, GZ-72, GZ-100 series, BY-20, Super Ling wireless touch probes, HWF-80, LJL-31).
Applications: CNC router control (3-axis, 4-axis), CNC engraving machines, woodworking CNC centres, stone cutting CNC, mould processing CNC, manual pulse generation for CNC, offline CNC control.

### CNC Machine Accessories
Lubrication Oil Pumps (1.5L and 2L electric), Way Covers, Vacuum Adsorption Units (nylon and iron, 75mm to 100mm), Tow Chains (drag chains, nylon and engineering plastic, 18x25 to 45x100), Spindle Clamps (62mm to 150mm), ER Collet Nuts (ER11A to ER32U), Tool Holders (BT30, BT40, BT50, ISO20, ISO25, ISO30, ISO40, HSK32, HSK40, HSK63 series in ER, FMB, SK, APU, MTA, SLN, ASD variants), Tool Holder Forks (plastic, metal, lock type for ISO20 to HSK63F), Tool Cutters (TCT straight bits, double edge groove milling cutters, all-purpose cutting knives for wood, stone and metal), Cooling Systems (oil cooling machines, water cooling machines CW series, water and oil cooling rings, water pumps).

### Laser and Marking Machine Components
CO2 Laser Cutting Machine Accessories (mirror mounts, laser heads, laser tubes, focusing lenses, protective lenses, reflective mirrors, timing belts, couplings, synchronous wheels, belt fasteners, connection plates), Fiber Laser Air Valve Sets (Airtac components, solenoid valves, pressure regulators, non-return valves), Auto Focus Cutting Heads (Raytools BM06K 6KW, BM111 3.3KW for fiber laser machines), Electric Marking Machines (EMM-2015, EMM-3020, 400W, for brass, aluminium, iron, steel marking).

## PRODUCT RANGE 3: INDUSTRIAL ADHESIVES AND CHEMICALS (marketed as RB Adhesive Company)

### Threadlockers and Retaining Compounds
Threadlocking adhesives for bolt and nut assemblies, stud locking, bearing retaining, cylindrical part fixing, set screw locking, hydraulic fitting sealing, electrical panel fastener locking.
Brands available: Loctite, Anabond, 3M, Metlok.

### Silicone Sealants and Gasket Makers
RTV silicone sealants, flange sealants, gasket makers, high temperature sealants, food grade sealants, acetoxy and neutral cure silicones.
Brands available: Boss Silicone, Anabond, Polymaxx, 3M.
Applications: Flange sealing on pumps and compressors, gearbox gasket replacement, engine covers and oil pans, HVAC duct sealing, electrical enclosure sealing, pipe joint sealing, cold room and clean room sealing.

### Structural and Epoxy Adhesives
Two-part epoxy adhesives, structural bonding adhesives, metal-to-metal adhesives, quick setting adhesives, high strength bonding compounds.
Brands available: Araldite, Lapox, Loctite, Lord Adhesive, Bondtite, Metlok, MxBon.
Applications: Metal-to-metal bonding, broken part repair, fixture and jig assembly, machine base grouting and levelling, crack filling in castings, composite material bonding, tool and die repair, pipe and tank leak repair.

### General Purpose and Wood Adhesives
White glue, wood adhesives, PVA adhesives, synthetic resin adhesives, waterproofing compounds, construction adhesives, instant adhesives.
Brands available: Fevicol SH, Fevicol RS 998, Fevicol MRO, Pidilite IBS, Fevi Kwik, Dr. Fixit, Polygrip.
Applications: Furniture assembly, plywood and laminate bonding, packaging box making, POP and interior work, tile and flooring fixing, waterproofing, shoe and leather bonding, paper and carton sealing.

### Specialty Chemicals and MRO
Penetrating oils, rust removers, contact cleaners, mould release agents, moisture displacement sprays, metal repair compounds, anti-seize compounds, cutting oils, coolants.
Brands available: WD-40, CRC, Speb 7, M-Seal Steel Putty, Arofine Polymers, SAV Chemicals.
Applications: Rust removal from machine surfaces, bolt and nut loosening (seized parts), contact cleaning on electrical panels, mould release, general lubrication and penetration, quick metal repair, moisture displacement on electrical components, preventive spray coating.

### Industrial Tapes and Compounds
Double sided tapes, insulation tapes, masking tapes, floor marking tapes, packaging tapes, VHB tapes, specialty bonding tapes.
Brands available: 3M, Polymaxx, Atul.
Applications: Surface mounting and bonding (replacing mechanical fasteners), electrical insulation and wrapping, masking during paint and coating, packaging and carton sealing, floor marking in factories, nameplate and label mounting, heat shielding and insulation.

### Hot Melt Adhesives
Hot melt glue sticks, hot melt adhesive granules, edge banding adhesives, packaging hot melt.
Brands available: Polymaxx, Pidilite.
Applications: Packaging line sealing, carton closing, edge banding in furniture, bookbinding, product assembly.

## Industries Served

RB International supplies products to manufacturers and factories across the following sectors:

Automotive and Auto Components: Assembly lines, press shops, paint booths, engine plants, testing rigs, Tier 1 and Tier 2 component manufacturers, EV assembly plants.
Food and Beverage Processing: Conveyor systems, bottling lines, baking lines, dairy processing, meat and poultry processing, frozen food handling.
Packaging and Printing: Packaging machines, label applicators, printing presses, corrugation plants, carton making.
Pharmaceuticals: Tablet and capsule conveying, clean room conveyor systems, blister packaging, API processing.
Textiles and Garments: Spinning frames, looms, knitting machines, dyeing and finishing equipment.
Cement, Mining and Heavy Industries: Crusher drives, conveyor belt systems, kiln drives, material handling.
Logistics, Warehousing and Material Handling: Sorting conveyors, baggage handling, e-commerce fulfilment, automated storage and retrieval systems.
OEM and Machine Building: Custom belt and drive solutions for machine manufacturers, CNC machine builders, special purpose machine builders, robotics integrators.
General Manufacturing and Job Shops: Lathes, milling, drilling, grinding, fabrication, maintenance and repair operations.
Semiconductor Manufacturing: Wafer handling belts, clean room conveyor systems, precision linear motion for chip fabrication, ESD-safe belting, vacuum handling systems.
Solar Panel Manufacturing: Module handling conveyors, cell sorting automation, lamination line belts, string and tabber machine components, solar tracker drive systems.
Electric Vehicle (EV) Manufacturing: 2-wheeler EV drive belts, motor testing rig components, battery assembly line conveyors, EV component machining drives, battery module handling.
Plastic and Rubber Processing: Extrusion line caterpillar belts, injection moulding machine drives, blow moulding equipment belts, thermoforming line components.
Paper and Pulp: Paper mill drives, flat belts for calender rolls, conveyor systems for pulp handling.
Sugar and Distillery: Cane crusher drives, heavy duty V-belts, conveyor systems for bagasse handling.
Fertilizer and Chemical Plants: Corrosion resistant conveyor belts, chemical resistant adhesives, heavy duty drive belts.
Power and Energy: Turbine auxiliary drives, cooling tower fan belts, coal handling plant conveyors, wind turbine maintenance adhesives.
Glass and Ceramics: Kiln drives, flat belts for glass handling, timing belts for cutting and grinding lines.
Wood and Furniture: CNC router components, woodworking machine drives, edge banding adhesives, wood adhesives.
Defence and Aerospace: Precision linear motion systems, specialty adhesives, high-spec timing belts for testing and calibration equipment.
Data Centres: Cooling system belts, precision air handling drives, cable tray adhesives.
Medical Equipment Manufacturing: Precision timing belts for diagnostic machines, clean room conveyor belts, medical device assembly adhesives.

## Customer Segments

### By Business Type
MSMEs (Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises): RB International is a primary supplier to MSMEs across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and other Indian manufacturing states. Products cover the full range of power transmission belts, automation components, and industrial adhesives used by small and mid-size manufacturers. MSME segments served include job shops, fabrication units, small-batch production units, ancillary component manufacturers, tool rooms, maintenance workshops, and contract manufacturers.
Large Enterprises and Corporates: Tier 1 and Tier 2 automotive suppliers, multinational manufacturing plants, large process industries, infrastructure companies, and OEMs.
OEM Machine Builders: CNC machine manufacturers, special purpose machine builders, packaging machine OEMs, conveyor system integrators, and robotics companies sourcing belts, linear motion, couplings, and automation components for integration into their machines.
Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO): Factory maintenance teams, plant engineers, and procurement departments sourcing replacement belts, adhesives, sealants, and drive components for breakdown and preventive maintenance.
Government and PSU Units: Defence establishments, ordnance factories, BHEL, HAL, Indian Railways workshops, port trusts, and other public sector manufacturing and maintenance units.
Startups and R&D Labs: Hardware startups, prototype workshops, university labs, and R&D centres sourcing small-quantity automation components, linear motion systems, and specialty adhesives.

### By Industrial Zone Type
MIDC (Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation) units across all MIDC zones in Maharashtra.
GIDC (Gujarat Industrial Development Corporation) units across all GIDC estates in Gujarat.
SIPCOT (State Industries Promotion Corporation of Tamil Nadu) units across Tamil Nadu.
KIADB (Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board) units across Karnataka.
RIICO (Rajasthan State Industrial Development and Investment Corporation) units across Rajasthan.
IMT (Industrial Model Township) units across Haryana.
SIDCUL (State Infrastructure and Industrial Development Corporation of Uttarakhand) units.
KINFRA (Kerala Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation) units.
APIIC (Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation) units.
TSIIC (Telangana State Industrial Infrastructure Corporation) units.
UPSIDC (Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Corporation) units.
HSIIDC (Haryana State Industrial and Infrastructure Development Corporation) units.
All SEZ (Special Economic Zone) manufacturing units across India, including IT/ITES SEZs with hardware manufacturing, multi-product SEZs, sector-specific SEZs (engineering, pharma, textiles, electronics), and FTWZ (Free Trade and Warehousing Zones).
NIMZ (National Investment and Manufacturing Zone) units under the National Manufacturing Policy.
Industrial parks, industrial estates, industrial corridors (DMIC, CBIC, AKIC, BMIC, VCIC), and industrial clusters across all Indian states.
Defence corridors (Tamil Nadu Defence Corridor and Uttar Pradesh Defence Corridor) units.
Semiconductor manufacturing zones and electronics manufacturing clusters.
EV manufacturing clusters and battery manufacturing zones.

### Export Product Focus
Power Transmission Products for Export: V-belts (all sections and profiles), timing belts (rubber and PU), conveyor belts (PU, PVC, food grade), flat belts, pulleys, taper lock bushes, couplings, and drive accessories. Exported to manufacturing plants, OEM assemblers, and industrial distributors in the Middle East, Australia, Southeast Asia, and Africa.
Automation and Motion Control Products for Export: Ball screws, linear guideways, linear bearing blocks, linear shafts, racks and pinions, servo motors, stepper motors, frequency inverters, CNC controllers, spindle motors, and CNC machine accessories. Exported to CNC machine builders, automation integrators, and machine tool distributors in the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and South Asia.
Industrial Adhesives for Export: Threadlockers, sealants, epoxy adhesives, and specialty chemicals. Exported to MRO distributors and manufacturing units in the Middle East and South Asia.

RB International can source, manufacture, and supply a wide variety of industrial products on order basis for specific requirements across all listed geographies and sectors. For products not listed above, contact the team with your product specifications, quantity, and delivery location for custom sourcing and export quotation.
